work: Book mark, seal, signature, brand bible, announcement film

1.text: The open book was drawn by hand in ink, then cut down to a solid version for small sizes.

3.text: Left, the original ink drawing. Right, the solid version, still legible at the size of a favicon.

6.text: “For readers and writers” didn't need writing. It was already stitched into her label.

10.text: Sloop Script, tidied to be read rather than admired, with a custom S. The flourishes were politely declined.

14.text: Sailing Club capitals, Sloop Script, Cormorant Garamond italic and EB Garamond.

15.text: Every color carries Pantone, thread and foil references.

16.text: A second mark, for Sunny's Journal & Press, in the same world.

21.text: A 24-page brand bible, set like a book because it was for a bookshop. Behind it sit 46 pages of studies.

27.text: The announcement film sets the drawing, the type and the studies to the sound of the room.

hide: The hand-drawn open book in Library Green on vellum.
The book at three sizes: hero, digital and tiny.
The seal in black line on white: the book, the name round the ring and “For readers and writers.”

The stacked logo in ink on white.
The seal with its construction circles.
The Sunny’s Journal & Press stamp, half inked.
